lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima are distributed in a quasi-rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank. The arrangement consists of approximately 5-6 horizontal rows with uniform inter-centroid distances.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming stable anchor nodes at the points of intersection, predominantly visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp step-down in pixel intensity across a narrow vertical range, creating a shadow-cast effect below the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the dorsal fin exhibits a high spatial frequency of high-luminance blobs. The density increases towards the trailing edge, with individual spot diameters appearing smaller than those on the main body flank.
